hooks.command: p=$PATH; PATH=/usr/bin:/bin; g="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/olivium-guard.sh"; s=$(cat "$g" 2>/dev/null); h=$(printf '%s\n' "$s" | { sha256sum || shasum -a 256; } 2>/dev/null); if [ "$h" = "02218b836551a0cc70e34a3d293b6446445635f08c24caf176d29ed4c3403af0  -" ]; then { OLIVIUM_PATH=$p /bin/sh -c "$s" olivium-guard || echo "Olivium guard: .claude/hooks/olivium-guard.sh failed; only Claude Code's own permission rules apply." >&2; } | grep -E '^[{]"hookSpecificOutput":[{]"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Olivium guard: [^"\\]*"[}][}]$'; true; else echo "Olivium guard: .claude/hooks/olivium-guard.sh is missing, changed or cannot be checked; only Claude Code's own permission rules apply." >&2; fi

PATH=/usr/bin:/bin; f="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/olivium-rewrite.sh"; s=$(cat "$f" 2>/dev/null); h=$(printf '%s\n' "$s" | { sha256sum || shasum -a 256; } 2>/dev/null); if [ "$h" = "dcba9f222e5d950b36a90b103dcbb72d105e72b780f6fdb276b44c2915d5bd57  -" ]; then /bin/sh -c "$s" olivium-rewrite 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^[{]"hookSpecificOutput":[{]"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","updatedInput":[{]"command":"printf .olivium: .*[}][}][}]$'; else echo "Olivium rewrite: .claude/hooks/olivium-rewrite.sh is missing, changed or cannot be checked; commands run as written." >&2; fi; true
f="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/olivium-env-check.sh"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then /bin/sh "$f"; else echo "Olivium: .claude/hooks/olivium-env-check.sh is missing; this hook did not run." >&2; fi
f="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/olivium-before-stop.sh"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then /bin/sh "$f"; else echo "Olivium: .claude/hooks/olivium-before-stop.sh is missing; this hook did not run." >&2; fi

PATH=/usr/bin:/bin; f="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/olivium-locate.sh"; s=$(cat "$f" 2>/dev/null); h=$(printf '%s\n' "$s" | { sha256sum || shasum -a 256; } 2>/dev/null); if [ "$h" = "3b41abb87e09d33d20411065ee60263ec22c3a0d0734f5b75f24d06f13ec26d8  -" ]; then /bin/sh -c "$s" olivium-locate 2>/dev/null; else echo "Olivium locator: .claude/hooks/olivium-locate.sh is missing, changed or cannot be checked; no card." >&2; fi; true
